subject.title: refactor(push-web): move web push store to shared SQLite state DB

question: Should legacy Web Push JSON import remain a fail-closed gateway-startup task, or follow the database-first contract and be owned by doctor before runtime starts?
rationale: The submitted behavior follows the recent device-pairing precedent, but it conflicts with the repository's explicit doctor-owned migration rule and can make an otherwise usable gateway fail during upgrade.

options.title: Move import to doctor
options.body: Have doctor atomically import and verify both stores, archive the files, and let gateway startup read canonical SQLite state only.

options.title: Approve startup migration
options.body: Explicitly accept the startup availability change, add an in-product recovery path, and require full upgrade and corrupt-file gateway proof.

recommendation.title: Move import to doctor
recommendation.body: Have doctor atomically import and verify both stores, archive the files, and let gateway startup read canonical SQLite state only.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest merged shared-state migration precedent and database-first guidance both trace to this adjacent work.
